author: Hotochin
text:
Hey Peds!

I took this chart from a recent post in Kerooos journal. I thought I
would ask you one more thing here. So I commented on the high 1 and high
 2. My thought was that the sign was the engulf of the source of high 1.
 Thats what I was pointing too with the red arrow. This seems to trip me
 up and give me false signals. Maybe I am looking at the individual
candles too much. So how about looking at pulse and impulsive moves? I
have re-marked the chart and that seems to give me the correct analysis.
 So now the black lines would be marking the move up, the pullback, and
the second leg up that gets engulfed by the green line. Does that make
more sense?

Thanks,

H

author: Pedini
text:
So Gold has come off some very large TF levels, so I hope nobody has
been caught off guard by the recent bull market. There will also be
opportunities in the near term for larger investors to join in. I have
drawn in 3 levels, ones that most short to medium term traders will be
looking at. Now keeping in my the big picture (weekly) refer to the
three lines. Which line is going to be the most attractive to larger
investors to add longs? and what traps may day traders fall into by
trying to swing trade from levels 1 and 2?

Peds

 from levels 1 and 2?

Peds

Hi Peds.

Really appreciate you opening your journal with a puzzle like this.

Here is my analysis at my current stage of learning.

DAILY

H4

Now I consider your line 3 to be the one that will look most attractive to larger and long term investors.

Why?

- We have a flip zone here that price has reacted to in the past.

- This time on the way up price was too cheap and the supply was
completely disrespected so therefore we can expect that it will become a
 nice demand level if price makes it way back down.

- With price moving straight through this level I think there will still be many buy orders left here as well.

Although 1 & 2 would look attractive to day traders; looking into
the LTF we see that both these levels have been spiked consuming much of
 the demand at the decision points which should allow price to make it's
 way back down to the flip zone around 1350.

Just my thoughts as I said at my current stage of learning RTM.
